stem: More than 90% of anogenital warts are caused by which low-risk HPV types?

options.label: A
options.text: Only poliovirus serotypes numbered one through three
options.misconception: Polio. (does not match the cited teaching point).
options.explanation: This option does not match the cited source passage for the stem.

options.label: B
options.text: Only high-risk HPV types 16 and 18 in wart lesions
options.misconception: High-risk types. (does not match the cited teaching point).
options.explanation: Wrong class; see the cited source passage.

options.label: C
options.text: Low-risk HPV types 6 or 11 in most wart cases
options.explanation: CDC: >90% anogenital warts from types 6 or 11.

options.label: D
options.text: Only Haemophilus capsule serotypes labeled a-f
options.misconception: Hib. (does not match the cited teaching point).
options.explanation: This option does not match the cited source passage for the stem.

options.label: E
options.text: Only measles genotypes labeled A and B worldwide
options.misconception: Measles. (does not match the cited teaching point).
options.explanation: This option does not match the cited source passage for the stem.

context: Learning objective: recall hpv, warts from the cited FOSS source.
